OUTPUT.description: Folder of scores.jsonl, calibration.json and report.json when --out is not given.

SCOREKIT_INFERENCE_URL.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible gateway of the judge, ending in /v1, for example http://litellm:4000/v1. Required by score and calibrate.

SCOREKIT_INFERENCE_KEY.description: API key of the gateway, sent as a bearer token. Never write the value into a file.

LANGFUSE_HOST.description: Base URL of Langfuse for push.

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.description: Langfuse secret key for push. Never write the value into a file.

OSF_NOW.description: The time of new scores as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Default: the system clock.
